definitions.explanation: A luminous point in the night sky.

examples.japanese: {星|ほし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれいだ→きれい：00717_kirei⟧。
⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{星|ほし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Many stars are visible in the sky.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧{星|ほし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦きれいだ→きれい：00717_kirei⟧。
examples.english: The stars seen from the mountaintop are very beautiful.
On summer nights, it's fun to go outside with my father and look at the stars together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧、⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なると→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧、⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{星|ほし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しかった→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, every summer I would go to the mountains with my father, and it was fun to look at the stars together.

notes:
{星|ほし} refers primarily to stars visible in the night sky, not planets in scientific contexts.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {星|ほし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look at stars
- {星|ほし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: stars come out
- {星|ほし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{輝|かがや}く→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧: stars shine
- ⟦{流|なが}れ{星|ぼし}→流れ星：05049_nagareboshi⟧: shooting star
- ⟦{星空|ほしぞら}→星空：05048_hoshizora⟧: starry sky

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{星座|せいざ}→星座：06313_seiza⟧: constellation
- ⟦{一番星|いちばんぼし}→一番星：08953_ichibanboshi⟧: first star of evening
- ⟦{北極星|ほっきょくせい}→北極星：30629_hokkyokusei⟧: North Star

USAGE:
{星|ほし} also means rating stars (⟦{三|み}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧{星|ぼし} = three stars) and can refer to someone's destiny or fate in literary contexts.

SCIENCE NOTE:
In astronomy, ⟦{恒星|こうせい}→恒星：13043_kousei⟧ (fixed star) is the technical term, while ⟦{惑星|わくせい}→惑星：05052_wakusei⟧ refers to planets.

cross_references.label: planet — 星 in everyday use means a point of light in the night sky, not a planet
